'''Ettal Howrider''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who may have lived on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. She was said to be one of only six "beautiful women" on that planet, until she was supposedly shot.

==Behind the scenes==
There is some uncertainty as to whether or not Howrider is an actual person or simply a figment of [[Garik Loran]]'s imagination.
